name: Exenatide
description: A GLP-1 receptor agonist derived from exendin-4, marketed as twice-daily Byetta and as extended-release Bydureon, for type 2 diabetes.

systems.note: GLP-1 receptor agonism on the beta cell.
Renal impairment and acute kidney injury are labelled; the drug is renally cleared.
Hepatobiliary events reported in the class.

monitors.why: Renal clearance and labelled acute kidney injury.
